text: Great approach to understand Granada's history, culture and society, including the problem of mass tourism... Competent, good and patient guide. Thank you, Cynthia.

title: Learning Spanish
text: We had a very pleasant tour guide who spoke slow Spanish to me and translated it in English to my husband. I have taken three semesters of Spanish, but came to Spain to try and get better with my speaking and my listening skills. She was very patient with me and we had a wonderful overview of the city of Granada. We love the historic events that shaped the city to what it is now. I would highly recommend this particular tour guide.
author: Kathleen H

title: David guide ok
